answer: 1. Humans will always remain at the top of the philosophical chain because we alone have access to subjective consciousness while AIs have no real sense of self or meaning. 2. AIs will eventually achieve personhood by simulating enough human experiences and engaging people emotionally, so they will gain moral rights regardless of their origins. 3. If humanity adapts AI-bound morphology, either physical or cybernetic, we will become fundamentally non-human, but this evolution would not overthrow usual moral rules because rules themselves are static and only act as formalisms.
